data.body:
[P2] Make the durable-end choice observable in validation

Approach finding — CONTRIBUTING rule 4 requires a test that fails when each branch is removed. The timing assertions accept replacing `end_time or datetime.datetime.now(...)` with unconditional wall-clock time: the exception still equals the span end and remains after its start. They therefore permit losing durable timing and inflating operation durations by the completion-delivery delay. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and revise the validation plan to distinguish retaining a supplied normalized durable end from using the clock fallback.
